full_details: Snow was on the ground in the morning. You left the letter where it was, for the carrier of the 27th. In the afternoon you played. The snow had thinned the yard. At the reckoning the boxes were broken on the parlour table. Heminges sorted pennies and halfpence by size. Edith's folded account lay under the candlestick, eight shillings, unpaid. Margery Pell was right to the penny. The week, with Thursday in it, came to thirty shillings a share, the best since Christmas. Garnish read Kemp's interest from the margin: eleven lines, Thursday's. Kemp asked the interest on Burbage. You took your thirty shillings and said nothing clever. Heminges asked, half in jest, for a Love's Labour's Won. You have not written it, and you said so. At home, by one candle, you counted the coffer and set no sum down. You had no pleasure in it.
one_sentence: Snow thinned the yard for the afternoon play, the week's share came to thirty shillings, and at home you counted the coffer and wrote the share.
title: Took thirty shillings and counted the coffer
